adjudication.rationale: In `Discourse.Group#removeMember`, it calls `self.findMembers()` without adjusting `offset`. In `findMembers`, the request offset is clamped using the *current* `this.get("user_count")` (`Math.min(this.get("user_count"), ...)`), which is stale immediately after a deletion. If you delete the only member on the last page (e.g., `user_count` drops from 51 to 50 while `offset` remains 50), `findMembers` will still request `offset=50`, and `GroupsController#members` will return an empty `members` array because it applies `limit(...).offset(offset)` with the now-smaller total. Nothing in the diff steps the offset back to the previous page, so the UI can get stuck on an empty page.
